_meta.purpose: Real published IKEA furniture, delivery and assembly prices in five countries, for a life-simulation game that requires sourced figures.
_meta.method: Each price was read from the IKEA country website's own product or service page with WebFetch (confirmed:true). Search-result snippets were used only to locate pages. Where a page showed a temporary reduction, value is the price shown on the retrieval date and regularPrice records the undiscounted price.
_meta.priceBasis: Prices are as displayed to an anonymous visitor: consumer prices including VAT/IVA in GB, IE and MX; before sales tax in US and CA. Delivery fees are non-member (not IKEA Family) rates.
_meta.sourceTypes: primary = IKEA's own country website; secondary = a third party (Sleep Foundation).

mattressLife.statement: Under normal conditions, mattresses should be replaced every 6 to 8 years.
mattressLife.byType: Latex 'upwards of 8 years'; lower-quality innerspring and all-foam have the shortest lives; hybrids 'tend to be more durable'. No per-type year ranges beyond latex.
mattressLife.note: Consumer Reports guidance was not retrieved. IKEA's own VALEVÅG warranty is 10 years, which is a warranty term, not a lifespan.

uncertain: Several GB and IE prices were temporary or recent reductions on 2026-09-29 (GB MALM valid from 21 Sep while supply lasts); regularPrice records the undiscounted figure and may be the better long-run value.

UK and Irish 'Standard Double' is 135x190 cm, not 140x200; the 150x200 size is sold as 'Standard King', which is what was recorded for GB and IE bed frames and mattresses, while US, CA and MX use Queen (152x203/202 cm).
The US MALM product page titles the item 'MALM bed frame' without the word 'high', but it carries the same article number (s19931605) that ikea.com/ca and ikea.com/mx title as the high frame.
US and Canadian delivery figures are 'starting at' floors; the checkout quote varies by postal code and order weight.
Canada's cheapest furniture delivery ($39 Doorstep) is capped at 150 kg per order and 30 kg per package, so a bed-plus-sofa order would likely need In-Home Delivery at $59.

Ireland's assembly figure (€40) is only the call-out fee; the per-product assembly rate is not published. US, GB and CA assembly figures are Taskrabbit minimums, with per-item rates quoted only in the cart.
Mexico's truck delivery zones come from the ikea.com/mx FAQ; the delivery service page renders prices only after a postal code is entered and could not be read directly.
